scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:win:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never -c.npmRebuild=true
scripts.dist:mac:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --config electron-builder.yml --publish never -c.npmRebuild=true
scripts.docs:word: npx --yes @mohtasham/md-to-docx docs/user/INSTALACE-MAC.md docs/user/Casomira-instalace-Mac.docx && npx --yes @mohtasham/md-to-docx docs/user/NAVOD-PRO-TESTERY.md docs/user/Casomira-navod-pro-testery.docx
